scope: annual detection-sensitive fallback only; conventional filters before any decision-structure exposure

inspected_before_freeze: published sampling-effort design used to define temporal scopes

pooled_change.reason: pooling gains and losses mixes two distinct risk sets

frozen_predictors.name: flower_abundance
frozen_predictors.transform: log1p then z-score within training fold

completeness.primary_missingness_policy: complete case on the frozen conventional predictor set

model_family.type: separate binomial logistic models for gain and loss
model_family.formula_policy: main effects only; no data-driven interactions
model_family.transition_handling: leave-one-transition-out temporal cross-validation within each frozen sampling-effort scope
model_family.primary_comparison: conventional-filter model versus null on held-out transitions
model_family.coefficient_status: secondary descriptive; predictive holdout performance is the Stage-1 gate

promotion_gate.pass: in the strict_core_2008_2011 primary scope, at least one of gain/loss conventional models improves held-out log-loss over the null without pathological prediction failure; both sensitivity scopes are reported regardless of direction
promotion_gate.fail: neither endpoint improves held-out log-loss in strict_core_2008_2011, or the primary scope is non-estimable
promotion_gate.interpretation: PASS means conventional filters carry reproducible information about annual link dynamics; it does not validate routeability

claim_firewall: do not tune predictor definitions after seeing coefficients or skill
do not call annual positive-link presence true species presence
do not promote annual fallback over the 18-subseason primary design
do not interpret predictive improvement as a causal effect

anti_leakage.policy: use independently measured raw morphology and phenological overlap; do not import interaction-derived trait-matching scores into the link-change predictor set
anti_leakage.reason: an interaction-derived matching score could reuse the response network and make the conventional-filter benchmark circular
anti_leakage.original_paper_trait_matching: treated as literature context, not as a frozen predictor in this prospective link-change audit
